purpose: Development-only performance comparison; all fixed model recipes are independently scored on the blind test without retuning.
validationCohort: All 57 frozen development-validation field cases; never filter to correct predictions.
order: Listed order in round one; reverse order in round two. Fresh isolated Chromium for every run. No concurrent training, native prediction or other benchmark job.
runtimeChoice: Worker micro2 and default arena selected from development probes before blind evaluation. Report observed native/browser choice changes rather than assuming score equivalence.
latency: Per-field tokenization plus inference, with chunk times summed; automatic NONE-only cases separately reported. Cold first case retained. DOM/template/fixture I/O/load/reporting excluded from this latency.
processingLatency: Also report complete per-field batch processing: encoding, padding/parity validation, tensor construction, inference/readback and disposal. DOM/template/fixture I/O/load/reporting remain excluded.
reportTransport: Incremental per-case progress crosses worker/main/host boundaries; cumulative rows retained only in the model worker and host, with complete final report transferred at teardown.
memory: Whole isolated Chromium process-set working set/private bytes at fixed milestones; sampled maximum, not continuous peak or model-only memory. Report absolute and baseline delta. Worker termination sampled immediately and after one second.
responsiveness: 16ms main-thread interval gaps including load/reporting/browser scheduling; diagnostic only, not user event latency.
failurePolicy: Tokenization/runtime/shape errors retained as failures; never convert to automatic NONE or drop from the accuracy denominator.
changePolicy: If a runner defect requires correction after the source freeze, retain the failed artifact, disclose the correction and rerun every affected comparable configuration without model/gold changes.
